name: Dechala the Denied One
canonNotes: Mistress of the Tormentors, greatest of Slaanesh's warbands in the Chaos Wastes, as cruel and pitiless as she is beautiful and beguiling.
Seeks the ultimate self-indulgence and freedom from all law, for herself alone; her Thralls are victims whose will she has eroded.
voiceNotes: Beguiling, cruel and selfish; speaks of pleasure, pain and possession.
Treats others as playthings or future Thralls.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
